steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hope I didn't keep you waiting. The L.G.D. meeting took a little longer than expected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't worry about it, Madam Ch'en.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (She looks like nothing ever happened...)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: How's the situation?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Our scout team has already sent back some information.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I went through it and picked out a few things that might interest you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, Inspector Hoshiguma...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Don't worry about me. I'm just going to listen in.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Continue, Amiya. It's fine.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Very well. We managed to get a lead from some Infected...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The scout team has already confirmed that there are several Reunion hideouts in Lungmen's residential district.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A number of Reunion squads are already planning to launch an attack against Lungmen's defenses.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We even found an infiltration channel that Reunion had been using.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hah. Such arrogance.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: They seem to be underestimating the L.G.D.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What about the ruins of Chernobog?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island dispatched multiple recon squads there.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: While most of the residents were gone, we did find many Reunion members still active there.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: One team even had more than three encounters with Reunion forces.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: However, based upon the intel we have, we are unable to conclusively link the movements in the city to any broader Reunion operations...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I would recommend choosing this city as one of our important operation targets in the future.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma, help bring me my forms. Third drawer on the left side of my desk.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Right now? Sure thing.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Continue.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mm, to summarize...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island suggests a joint operation to completely eliminate the remaining Reunion forces in Lungmen.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No good.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The L.G.D. will not permit it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...What? Madam Ch'en...?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I said, no.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You... are an Infected.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If you carry out any more missions in the slums, you'll only cause greater disorder.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This is our decision.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But--

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, excuse me, I need to take this call...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is Amiya.
Is, is this Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...! Jessica?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Yes, Jessica here...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you on a stealth mission? I can barely hear you...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: We found them in the city ruins...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Reunion's leaders...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: There are... two of them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: So, you fled back here with your tail between your legs?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I am no mongrel like you and your lowly kind.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: ...If not for the fact that you completed your mission, I would have added two more scars to your filthy face.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Didn't you lose all your limbs in that explosion? I'd feel sorry making a kid like you put makeup on my face with your mouth.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Pah.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But let's set this aside for now... It's not doing either of us any good.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I'll admit to that much.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Then, have they taken the bait?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Surely. Let's just see if that old flag-waver can bring back the real goods.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Speaking of which, you're pretty scared of that old timer, aren't you?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I'm already in a bad mood.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh my, sorry 'bout that.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But that's just before we land the catch, right?

steps.name: W
steps.text: How about we put aside our differences for the time being?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Tch. Fine.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I'll deal with the small fry first.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Rhodes Island, I know you're there.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: ...It's impossible to hide from me.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Jessica, don't!

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: It could be a trap...!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: He found us! We have to...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: If we defeat the enemy leader... We have to...!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Huh. They really were here.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Where'd you come from, little kitty~?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You can't just treat this place like your playground.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Hey, you bunch.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Yessir!!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Before we get to feast upon the most sumptuous prey...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Help yourself to the appetizers.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Ohhh... Ohhhhh! !

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Tsk...!
